div.head: Ine 5
div.ab: Gif hwa sy deaðes scyldig ⁊ he cirican geyrne, hæbbe his feorh ⁊ bete, swa him ryht wisie.
XLVIIII. Gif hwa sie deaðes scyldig ⁊ he cirican geierne, hæbbe his feorh ⁊ bete, swa him ryht wisige.
Si quis sit mortis reus et ad ecclesiam confugiat, uitam habeat et emendet, sicut rectum sibi consulet.
{XLVIIII} Gif swa he deaðes scyldig ⁊ he cirican geierne, hæbbe his feorh ⁊ bete, swa him ryht wisige.
If someone has commited an offense for which he owes his life and he flees into a church, let him keep his life and make restitution according to how [judgment of] law directs him.
If anyone is liable to the death penalty, and he flees to a church, his life shall be spared and he shall pay such compensation as he is directed [to pay] by legal decision.
If anyone is liable to the death penalty and he reaches a church, he is to retain his life and to compensate as the law directs him.
Wenn jemand Todes schuldig ist und er eine Kirche erreicht, so behalte er sein Leben und büsse, wie ihm [das] die Rechtsordnung zuweist.
If someone is liable to death and he reaches a church, let him keep his life and pay compensation as the law directs him.
